verses.text:
To the Overseer.—A Psalm of David.
Till when, O Jehovah,
Dost Thou forget me?—for ever?
Till when dost Thou hide Thy face from me?

Till when do I set counsels in my soul?
Sorrow inn my heart daily?
Till when is mine enemy exalted over me?

Lest mine enemy say, ‘I overcame him,’
Mine adversaries joy when I am moved.

And I, in Thy kindness I have trusted,
Rejoice doth my heart in Thy salvation.

I do sing to Jehovah,
For He hath conferred benefits upon me!
